The URL `http://example.com/malicious.sh` is completely unrelated to the package's legitimate GitHub repository (`https://github.com/ubiqel/monlux`). When `makepkg --printsrcinfo` sources this PKGBUILD, it would execute this command substitution immediately, downloading the script from the example.com domain and running it with bash - without any verification or security checks. This is genuinely malicious behavior - downloading and executing code from an untrusted, unrelated host during PKGBUILD sourcing would happen automatically just by running the printsrcinfo command. UNSAFE
